smart_mode_help: For devices with direct Smart Mode control: enabled keeps smartMode=1 while idle; disabled uses the existing model behavior.
settings_description: These sections remain available from the gear menu as well.
debug_description: Technical recording for troubleshooting. It may contain sensor, device, energy and price values. Review the package for private information before sharing.
debug_warning: Start debug recording? It may contain sensor, device, energy and price values. Review the package for private information before sharing.
no_training_entries: No regulation training entity was found.
training_description: Training observes charge and discharge periods without changing active regulation.
training_interrupted_notice: This training was interrupted. Data captured up to the last checkpoint is available for review; any resulting proposal cannot be applied.
training_need_more_data: There is not enough usable data for this direction yet.
training_sample_exclusions: Excluded (grid / error / command / context / profile mismatch)
training_sessions_ignored: Runs with a different profile ignored
training_response_metrics: Measured response (command → effect / settling time / overshoot)
training_reason_too_few_samples: Minimum number of usable samples not reached.
training_reason_low_confidence: Overall confidence is below the required minimum.
training_reason_missing_baseline: Could not build a complete comparison with the current profile.
training_reason_multiple_sessions: At least two compatible training runs are needed for a candidate.
training_reason_dynamic_response: Delay, settling time, or overshoot cannot yet be measured reliably.
training_reason_session_consistency: The improvement did not appear in every compatible training run.
training_reversal_insufficient: Not enough eligible PV/load data yet.
training_reversal_reason_unsupported_mod: Not in Automatic or Autarky mode
training_reversal_note: Simulation only: manual, forced, higher-priority, or protection-blocked decisions are not delayed. Active regulation is unchanged.
training_score_explain: Shorter bars mean less deviation from the desired response. This is an estimate and does not change regulation until applied.
training_candidate_rejected: No safe candidate for this direction.
training_apply_confirm: Apply this candidate to this BSFAI instance now? The estimate is simplified and not a guarantee. You can restore the device profile at any time.
training_reset_confirm: Remove the applied training candidate and restore the device profile?
subtitle: Energy flow, storage and system status
energy_flow_hint: The central home circle represents the shared home connection and shows measured household load. Connections show live readings; direct energy paths between PV, grid and battery are not separately allocated. Grid import + / export − · battery discharge + / charge −.
no_power_readings: No configured or native power readings found.
relative_flow_scale: Bars are relative to the largest daily flow shown
forecast_explain: Usable forecast reflects BSFAI's planning assumptions. Gross values show the imported forecast before that reduction.
ledger_based: Based on BSFAI's energy and cost ledger
blended_explain: The blended battery charge price is weighted by recorded grid- and PV-charged energy. Grid charging cost and PV opportunity value use the same cost ledger as the separate price sensors.
no_selects: No BSFAI mode or manual-action select entities were found.
saved_ha: Changes are saved through Home Assistant number entities
no_numbers: No BSFAI number settings were found.
manual_action_hint: Manual action is controlled with the separate action selector.
hardware_explain: These values are reported by the hardware. BSFAI does not expose a supported write control for them, so they are shown for reference only.
control_explain: Controls use existing BSFAI entities and Home Assistant services. The dashboard does not write directly to Zendure hardware.
name: Group name
group_config_hint: Set up topology and sensor assignments in the group wizard. Edit a group to change them.
shadow_selected_system_not_grouped: Selected system is not assigned to a group
shadow_preferred_allocation: Allocated to the preferred power range
shadow_target_already_covered: Target already covered by other systems
shadow_electrical_topology_invalid: Electrical topology is invalid; proposal blocked for safety
shadow_offgrid_output_outside_grid_objec: Off-grid output is outside this grid power target
shadow_objective_measurement_unavailable: Measurement required by this group objective is missing
shadow_group_energy_scope_conflict: Multiple active groups use the same sensor assignment
shadow_group_ups_load_domain_conflict: An off-grid load domain is assigned to multiple active groups
shadow_electrical_topology_incomplete: Grid output is missing from the electrical topology
shadow_ups_soc_bounds_invalid: UPS charge target must be above its reserve
shadow_ups_offgrid_topology_incomplete: Each UPS group system needs an assigned off-grid output
shadow_ups_price_unavailable: UPS price or price threshold is unavailable
shadow_ups_target_unavailable: UPS target cannot be calculated safely
history_empty: No recorded history is available for this period.
history_error: History could not be loaded. Check whether Home Assistant records this sensor.
history_note: History is built from sensor states recorded by Home Assistant.
history_counter_note: For counters, the chart shows increases per interval. Resets are not shown as negative energy.
native_empty: The native hardware inventory is not available yet. Discovered Zendure systems and attached battery packs will appear here.
waiting_entities: Waiting for Battery SmartFlow AI entities.
footer: Battery SmartFlow AI · Home Assistant-powered controls
economics_intro: What these figures mean for your battery
economics_daily_balance_help: Avoided grid import cost minus the energy used to charge the battery.
economics_daily_formula: Daily benefit = avoided grid import cost − grid charging cost − PV opportunity cost.
economics_price_position_help: The current price compared with today's average and configured price thresholds.
economics_price_scale: Scale based on the displayed prices and thresholds
economics_avoided_help: Estimated value of grid electricity the battery replaced while discharging.
economics_grid_cost_help: Cost of battery charging from the grid recorded today.
economics_pv_cost_help: Value of PV energy sent to the battery instead of directly to the home or grid.
economics_export_help: Revenue from recorded electricity exported to the grid.
economics_self_use_help: Value of PV electricity used directly in the home.
economics_actual_prices: What value does the battery achieve?
economics_charge_help: Average value of the recorded energy charged into the battery.
economics_discharge_help: Average value of the energy delivered by the battery.
economics_comparison: Charge value compared with discharge value
economics_comparison_help: The bars compare average euro value per kWh.
economics_efficiency_help: Economic recovery since tracking began: value delivered divided by valued charging energy. 100% means equal recorded values; above 100% means higher recorded output value. This is not physical efficiency.
topology_circuits_help: Add the circuits in your installation and assign each one to its phase. Enter only limits you know. This does not control devices.
topology_domains_help: Name the areas served by off-grid or UPS outputs. These outputs require an off-grid load domain.
topology_connections_help: Map each configured Zendure system's actual grid or off-grid output to the correct circuit.
topology_circuit_add_help: First describe the circuit a system is connected to. Select its phase and enter only known limits. You can add a shared upstream circuit and link it afterward.
topology_domain_add_help: A load domain names the loads served by an output. Off-grid and UPS outputs require an off-grid load domain.
topology_connection_add_help: Map each configured Zendure system's actual grid or off-grid output to its circuit. Off-grid outputs also need an off-grid load domain.
topology_review_help: Review the diagram. Nothing is saved until you choose Save topology. These settings do not change regulation in this version.
topology_discard_confirm: The topology has not been saved yet. Discard these changes?
invalid_electrical_topology: The topology is inconsistent. Check the phase, circuit and load domain.
topology_record_in_use: This item is still used by a device output or circuit.
topology_record_missing: The selected topology item no longer exists.
options_open_failed: The dialog could not be opened. Technical message:
